hotel.name: JW Marriott Clearwater Beach Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the quieter south end of Clearwater Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seated on the quieter, south end of the beach, this is a remarkably secluded alcove made for retreat.

verified_facts.text: The resort is on the southern end of Clearwater Beach, near the Clearwater Marine Aquarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled along the southern end of Clearwater Beach, near the Clearwater Marine Aquarium

verified_facts.text: Guests have an exclusive beach with chairs and umbrellas, with cabanas available as an upgrade.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bask on our exclusive beach with chairs and umbrellas or upgrade to a cabana for extra comfort.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool has sweeping Gulf views, with cabanas and loungers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in sweeping Gulf views from the rooftop pool, complete with cabanas and loungers.

verified_facts.text: The pool is on the 11th floor.
Spa by JW has locker rooms, a steam room and a sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa by JW at JW Marriott Clearwater Beach offers locker rooms, a steam room, a sauna, and spa services for everyone.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers one-, two- and three-bedroom Residences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bring the whole family and settle into our premium 1-, 2-, or 3-bedroom Residences

verified_facts.text: Each Residence has a kitchenette, an in-room washer and dryer, and a living area with floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors.
verified_facts.excerpt: features a spacious kitchenette, in-room washer & dryer, and an inviting living area framed by floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors that open to the coast

verified_facts.text: Suites feature plush carpeting, touches of turquoise in a largely eggshell palette, landscape paintings and spacious private balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Plush carpeting, touches of turquoise in a largely eggshell-forward palette, tasteful landscape paintings that border on abstract, and spacious private balconies make up the subtle suite design

verified_facts.text: The Hideaway Hangout kids club is designed for children ages 5 to 10.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hideaway Hangout is a vibrant space that is designed to inspire curiosity and joy in children ages 5-10.

verified_facts.text: Wellness classes include beachfront morning meditation, yoga and qi gong.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wellness classes at our Clearwater fitness center include but are not limited to Beachfront Morning Meditation, Yoga, and Qi Gong.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore Clearwater Beach with complimentary bike rentals.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore Clearwater Beach with complimentary bike rentals

verified_facts.text: Water activities include eco kayak tours, kayaks and stand-up paddleboarding lessons.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore tranquil waters with eco kayak tours, glide solo or in tandem on kayaks, master stand-up paddle boarding with lessons

verified_facts.text: The Deep End is an 11th-floor rooftop bar with craft cocktails and Gulf views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 11th floor, The Deep End is a rooftop bar in Clearwater Beach, Florida, that offers craft cocktails, unique menu items, and endless Gulf views

verified_facts.text: Latitude 28 is open for breakfast and dinner with indoor and outdoor seating.
verified_facts.excerpt: Latitude 28 is open for breakfast and dinner and offers both indoor and outdoor seating.

verified_facts.text: The closest airport is St Petersburg-Clearwater International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near JW Marriott Clearwater Beach Resort & Spa is St Petersburg-Clearwater International Airport (PIE).

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Pets are not allowed at the beach, pool or restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: No pets at the beach, pool, or restaurants.
